_comment: Settings of the running experiment (owner's explicit choices, 12-13 Nov 2026): SIMULATED 3x LEVERAGE, validated strategies up to 50% of equity per position, 5% equity risk per trade, no forward test, exploration of 6 unvalidated crypto strategies at up to 15% per position with a 150 EUR loss budget. New trades pause at -10% in a day or -20% from the peak; margin call force-closes everything if equity falls below 22% of exposure.
